final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM client c JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.region AS region, s1.cnt AS cnt, CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total AS share FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL AND s2.total <> 0), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.region, s3.cnt, s3.share, s3.share - s4.avg_share AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.share > s4.avg_share) SELECT SUM(cnt), AVG(share), AVG(diff) FROM s5
